identity.description: An attacker uses RDP to connect from an unmanaged device into a typically managed subnet, triggering a detection for unusual RDP access patterns. This behavior is modeled by simulating an RDP connection from an unexpected IP address within a managed network segment.

expected_artifacts.description: RDP connection initiated from an unmanaged endpoint to a managed subnet

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: RDP from Unmanaged Endpoint
biocs.description: Detection of RDP activity originating from an endpoint not recognized as managed within the subnet.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECT
| filter action_remote_ip != null and dst_port = 3389
| filter actor_process_image_name contains 'rdpclient.exe'
| comp count() as events by action_remote_ip, agent_hostname
| sort desc events

abiocs.name: Unmanaged RDP Access Pattern
abiocs.description: Detection of RDP access from an IP address not in the known managed endpoint list, within a typically managed subnet.
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECTION and event_sub_type = ENUM.NETWORK_CONNECT
| filter action_remote_ip != null and dst_port = 3389
| comp count() as events by action_remote_ip, agent_hostname
| sort desc events
abiocs.causality_anchor: RDP connection initiated by unmanaged host
